remarks: Location, Location, Location - this sunny, bright upscale townhouse consisting of 3BR 2.5 bath Condo in Downtown Stamford is available for rent immediately. Built in 2016, it has hardwood floors through out the unit. The entry level has a den area that can be used as an office. The main level consists of the kitchen, living room, dining area are powder room. Don't miss the high-end appliances and beautiful trims. Go up one level and two lovely bedrooms with a full bath. The next level is the primary bedroom with walk in closest and full bath and your very own private rooftop deck.  A location you can't miss - walk to downtown Stamford to restaurants, movies and all that Stamford has to offer. Short drive to the train station, I-95 and the Merritt. Close to health clubs, parks and play-grounds too.
